description: This PHP class defines a validator for CKEditor5 plugin styles, ensuring styles are only applied to supported HTML5 tags and classes, and checking for conflicts with other plugins or unsupported tags.

classes.name: StyleSensibleElementConstraintValidator
classes.description: A validator class for ensuring CKEditor5 style plugin styles are applied only to supported HTML5 tags and classes, and do not conflict with other plugins or unsupported tags.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given element against the style constraints, checking for HTML5 support, plugin conflicts, and unsupported tags.

methods.name: intersectionWithClasses
methods.description: Checks if there is an intersection in allowed class attribute values between two HTMLRestrictions objects.

methods.name: findStyleConflictingPluginLabel
methods.description: Finds and returns the label of a plugin that conflicts with the given style element based on class support.
